sources.title: openral/rskills/act-aloha at master - GitHub
sources.snippet: OpenRAL rSkill — ACT (Action Chunking Transformer) finetuned on the ALOHA bimanual cube-transfer task, packaged for OpenRAL. This package wraps lerobot/act_aloha_sim_transfer_cube_human with a rskill.yaml manifest that adds capability checking, license surfacing, latency budgets, and local registry integration. It does not copy model weights.

sources.title: openral/rskills/act-aloha-insertion at master - GitHub
sources.snippet: It is the harder sibling of rskill-act-aloha-aloha_transfer_cube-fp32 (cube transfer) and demonstrates how a single packaging format covers multiple task-specific checkpoints from the same paper.
